layman_headline: Market is quietly recovering but no strong new trades are showing up yet.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a mild fear zone but improving from deeper fear levels last week. We already hold two positions — Solana (up ~1%) and Chainlink (roughly flat). The swing trade candidates on today's watchlist are either lacking technical data (no RSI or MACD readings), already extended after big weekly moves, or are stablecoins with no upside. Without a clear high-conviction setup, the best move is to sit tight and let our existing trades develop.
layman_action: No new trades today. Hold existing SOL and LINK positions, which are both within their planned trade ranges. Monitor stop-losses and wait for a cleaner setup to emerge.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool is exceptionally weak this cycle. VELVET (+13.9% 24h, +9.6% 7d) and PIEVERSE (+16% 7d) are already extended and lack RSI/MACD data for confirmation. FIL has pulled back -11.2% weekly but is down -99.7% from ATH, signaling structural decline rather than a bounce opportunity. WLD is similarly devastated at -97.3% from ATH. MON has a neutral RSI of 42.5 but no catalyst or volume confirmation. BTC dominance at 56.6% continues to suppress alt performance, making new alt entries risky. Our existing SOL and LINK positions have clear setups with defined risk — SOL targeting $85 with stop at $69.50, LINK targeting $10.90 with stop at $8.60. Both are in early stages of their trades and should be given time to play out.
